paper.title_en: Twisted Verlinde formulas for cyclic orbifolds and the order-two simple current of a vertex operator superalgebra
paper.abstract_en: Let $V=\Vev\oplus J$ be a simple vertex operator superalgebra with $\Vev$ simple, rational and $C_2$-cofinite, and let $G$ be a finite cyclic group acting faithfully on $\Vev$. For arbitrary twisted $V$-modules we prove: (1) for $G$ of arbitrary order, a twisted Verlinde formula for $\Vev$; (2) unitarity of the orbifold $S$-matrix block in generating sectors; (3) as a consequence, a formula for $N^{X_3}_{X_1,X_2}\pm N^{J\boxtimes X_3}_{X_1,X_2}$ as sums over $J$-orbits of $G$-stable untwisted modules, in which $J$-fixed points enter with weight two and in the minus sign, with a parity selection rule (read in $\mathbb Z/2\mathbb Z$) and a dimension sum rule; (4) simplicity of $V^G$. These results concern the $G$-graded fusion category of $\Vev$ together with the order two invertible object $J$ with $θ_J=-\dim_qJ$. The statements are tested numerically on six examples (odd and even orders up to $15$, both signs of $\dim_qJ$, $J$-fixed modules).
